url_fetch_guard: validate_public_url + DNS pinning, re-validated on every redirect (src/geo_optimizer/utils/http.py)
fetched_content: untrusted data; never executed; prompt-injection patterns are flagged, not removed
network_target: the URL, domain or sitemap passed, plus redirect targets and, where noted, the pages and sub-sitemaps its sitemap lists; any public host, private and internal addresses blocked

audit.network: target; with --sitemap or --max-pages also the sitemap's pages
audit.reads_config: .geo-optimizer.yml or .yaml in the working directory (when PyYAML is installed), unless --config <file>

fix.loads_plugins: installed geo_optimizer.checks entry points, no opt-out
fix.reads_config: .geo-optimizer.yml or .yaml in the working directory (when PyYAML is installed), unless --config <file>

llms.network: target site: robots.txt and common sitemap paths (unless --sitemap), the sitemap and its sub-sitemaps; every listed page with --fetch-titles; {base-url}/llms.txt with --check-drift (unless --llms-file)

diff.loads_plugins: installed geo_optimizer.checks entry points, no opt-out
diff.reads_config: .geo-optimizer.yml or .yaml in the working directory (when PyYAML is installed), unless --config <file>

coherence.network: target, including the sitemap's pages and sub-sitemaps

monitor.loads_plugins: installed geo_optimizer.checks entry points, no opt-out
monitor.reads_config: .geo-optimizer.yml or .yaml in the working directory (when PyYAML is installed), unless --config <file>

track.loads_plugins: installed geo_optimizer.checks entry points, no opt-out
track.reads_config: .geo-optimizer.yml or .yaml in the working directory (when PyYAML is installed), unless --config <file>

authority.network: target, including the sitemap's pages and sub-sitemaps

citations.network: the configured provider only: OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq (official SDK endpoints), api.perplexity.ai, generativelanguage.googleapis.com, api.deepseek.com, api.minimax.io, api.serpbase.dev (--provider serpbase)
citations.sends: only the query texts, built from --topic (default: the brand) or given with --query; the domain is matched locally; never page content

perception.loads_plugins: installed geo_optimizer.checks entry points, no opt-out

mcp_tools.network: target URL; geo_factual_accuracy also fetches up to 8 links found on the page, through the same guard
mcp_tools.claude_code_plugin: plugins/geo-optimizer/.mcp.json starts geo-mcp via uvx (needs uv); no other executable

geo_web.network: audit targets requested through its API; /api/stats calls api.github.com and pypistats.org; an external stats service only when GEO_STATS_API_URL is set; /api/citations calls Perplexity only when PERPLEXITY_API_KEY is set; competitive narrative calls the LLM provider whose key is in the environment, only when one is set
writes: a temporary .log file in the system temp directory (log upload)
geo_web.loads_plugins: installed geo_optimizer.checks entry points, no opt-out
